note: Exact UTA archive IDs independently verified as releases of the specified C64 game. Optional titleAliases are game-specific verified archive-title aliases; they never become global title substitutions. Curated approvals still require the listed archive ID, an exact normalized canonical/curated title match, and the existing year safeguard. Archive IDs are not assumed globally unique; release identity is preserved by its UTA directory URL.
